actionConfiguration.body:
select
    -- Visible tblPropForEvent columns
    v.proposal_number,
    v.proposal_status,
    v.active,
    v.updated_at,

    -- Identity / support columns
    v.id,
    v.event_id,
    v.proposal_no,
    v.proposal_title,
    v.event_name,
    v.event_ref,
    v.event_date,
    v.total_guests,
    v.sent_at,
    v.created_at,
    v.closed_at,
    v.was_issued,
    v.is_editable,
    v.is_closed,
    v.proposal_sequence_number

from public.vw_prop_selector v

join public.prop_items pi
  on pi.id = v.id

where v.client_id =
      '{{ appsmith.store.current_client_id }}'::uuid

  and v.event_id =
      {{ Number(appsmith.store.current_event_id || 0) }}

  and coalesce(pi.hidden, false) = false

order by
    case
        when v.proposal_status = 'Ordered' then 0
        when v.proposal_status = 'Accepted' then 1
        when v.proposal_status = 'Issued' then 2
        when v.proposal_status = 'Draft' then 3
        else 4
    end,

    coalesce(
        v.sent_at,
        v.created_at
    ) desc,

    v.id desc;
